192: To keep your PC working and secure
193: Disabling Windows services, 'magic' registry tweaks that need admin rights, bcdedit/HPET changes: no measurable benefit, they cause problems.
194: Disabling Memory integrity/VBS: gains 5-15% FPS in some tests but it is a security feature. The System page informs you and leaves the decision to you.

196: 'RAM cleaners' (standby list/ISLC): need admin rights and there is no independent measurement showing an FPS effect. For real gains close apps from the Background page; if RAM runs single-channel, add a second module (System page).
197: Timer resolution, core parking, pinning the game to specific cores: games set the timer themselves; the Ultimate/High performance plan disables core parking; reports on core pinning conflict (it increases stutter on some systems).
198: Turn off Windows animations and visual effects

207: Sets the Windows power slider to 'Best performance' during the game (the CPU boosts more aggressively) and returns to the previous mode when it closes. If your power plan is already High/Ultimate performance the slider has no effect and nothing is done. On laptops heat and battery use increase, within hardware limits.
